tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi sgrub thabs cho ga rig gtad dang bcas pa ngo mtshar u dumbā ra'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru saṃ buddhā ya/ thugs bskyed bsam yas rnam thar rmad du byung*// 'gro sgrol phrin las snying stobs ches dpa' ba// grags chen sangs rgyas bdun la gus btud nas// cho ga'i lag len tshul bzhin dgod par bya// de la rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa sgrol ba'i mgon pos gsar 'gyur gyi chos sde las sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi cho ga'i rim pa bklags chog tu dgod pa la gsum/ bdag bskyed bsnyen pa/ mdun bskyed sgrub mchod/ rig gtad bya ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su bris sku la sogs pa'i rten gyi spyan sngar stegs bu gtsang ma la chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar du bsham/ sgrub pa po gtsang sbra dang bcas te bde ba'i gdan la 'khod nas/ mchod pa/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i snod bzang po rnams su hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs pa bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swā hā/ pā dyaṃ swā hā/ puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ ghāṇḍe ra ṇi ta sogs kyis sngags lan gsum brjod la byin brlab bo// de nas thog mar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/ spyod 'jug las 'byung ba'i byang mchis lan gsum brjod pa'am/ dkyus su/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gzhal med khang gi dbus su/ rin po che dang pad zla'i gdan dgu la hūm̐ re re yongs su gyur pa las/

dbus su rang nyid rgyal ba shākya thub pa chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ shar du rnam gzigs sa gnon dang mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ byang shar du gtsug tor can mchog sbyin mnyam gzhag shar lhor thams cad skyob skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag nub tu 'khor ba 'jig ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ lho nub tu gser thub chos 'chad mnyam gzhag nub byang du 'od srungs g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba lta bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang gser mdog mtshan dpes spras pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing*/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis rang rang gi byang chub shing drung du bzhugs pa/ lho ru khro bo chen po sngon po mchan khung ral gri dang zhags pa bcug cing thal mo sbyar ba/ khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o// byang du phyag na rdo rje zhi ba ljang gu g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon gdan la brten pa rol pas bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o// sgo bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ ye shes pa gzhug pa ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur/ mchod pa ni/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ bdag bskyed bsnyen pa kho na'i skabs su 'og nas 'byung ba'i dkar phyogs gtor ma 'dir bsngo/ mdun bum dang sbrel skabs mi dgos/ gzungs sngags bzla ba ni/ thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ yig gi mthar so so'i sngags phreng gser gyi mdog can gsal bar gyur/

ces pa dang sku'i rnam pa la sems rtse gcig tu gtad la/ gtso bo shākya thub pa'i gzungs ni/ na mo buddha ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ tadya thā/ ghu me/ ghu me/ ma hā ghu me/ ta le ta le/ ma hā ta le/ tsa le tsa le/ ma hā tsa le/ dhu re dhu re/ ma hā dhu re/ ti ri ti ri/ ma hā ti ri/ ki li ki li/ ma hā ki li/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ma hā tsu ru/ mi li mi li/ ma hā mi li/ ti li ti li/ ma hā ti li/ dhu me dhu me/ ma hā dhu me/ tsa le tsa le/ ma hā tsa le/ khi ri khi ri/ ma hā khi ri/ tsi li tsi li/ ma hā tsi li swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs kyi gzungs ni/ na mo buddha ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ gha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ ha la ha la/ hi la hi la ya/ na mo dza ga na mi tsa nā ya/ na mo na maḥswā hā/ gtsug tor can gyi gzungs ni/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa/ pā tsa ya pā tsa ya/ sarba bhū tā nāṃ/ tstshinda ya/ kī la ya/ pa ra bidyā nāṃ swā hā/ thams cad skyob kyi gzungs ni/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ oṃ ka la ka la/ ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ ku lot+sā dha nā nāṃ ku ru sarba gra hā ṇāṃ swā hā/ log par dad sel gyi gzungs ni/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ na maḥkra ku tstshandā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ oṃ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ka ṭha ka ṭha/ ki ṭi ki ṭi/ ki ṭhi ki ṭhi/ ki ṭa pa ya na maḥswā hā/ gser thub kyi gzungs ni/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ na maḥka na ka mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samya ksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ sa ra sa ra/ sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ si ri si ri/ si rā ya/ dha ma dha ma/ dha ma dha ma/ dhu ma dhū ma/ dhu ma dhu mā ya/ na mo na maḥka na ka mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya swā hā/ 'od srung gi gzungs ni/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/

na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ oṃ ha ra ha ra/ ha ra ha ra/ ha ha ha/ na maḥkā shya pā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha ta saṃ myaksaṃ buddha ya/ siddhyan tu mant+ra pa da swā hā/ zhes pa rnams ci 'grub dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa spyi'i snying po ni/ na maḥsarba tā thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ a nu ga te/ oṃ ku ruṃ gi ni swā hā/ zhes gtso bor bzla'o// thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang yang snying ga'i sa bon la thim/ de'ang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su yal bar gyur/ ces bsdus la cung zad mnyam par bzhag slar rang dang snang ba thams cad lha'i 'khor lor gsal bar gyur/ ces mos la dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su lha'i snang ba dang ma bral ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bdun pa'i gzungs klog pa'am/ 'don pa ci nus su bya zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sku gzugs la phyag mchod rgya cher bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ gnas khang legs par brgyan pa'i gung du sangs rgyas bdun gyi sku brnyan bris 'bur gang rung dang*/ ma 'byor na thub pa'i dbang po'i sku brnyan tsam bshams pa'i mdun du/ bsgom bya dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor ras bris rdul tshon sogs 'grub na rab/ min na rgya gar ba'i lugs kyi maṇḍal me tog gsar pa'i tshom bu gtso 'khor dgu bkod pa bsham/ mdun tu 'das gtor cog zlum/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma rnams dkar gsum las bcos pa dang*/ chu gnyis/ nyer spyod lnga po brgya phreng ngam lha grangs sogs gang 'byor dang*/ ma 'byor na che ba gcig bsham mo// de nas sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa nas bzung*/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa bsdu ldang bar du btang*/ mdun rten/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ shū n+ya tās sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dag pa'i zhing gi rgyan bkod pa rmad du byung ba dang ldan pa'i mdun gyi gzhir thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad la rin po che'i khri padma dang zla ba'i gdan re re gsal bar gyur/

dbus dang 'khor gyi gdan drug la hūm̐ yig gser gyi mdog can re re/ lhor sngon po/ byang du ljang gu rnams 'od 'bar ba'o// de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su bdag cag gi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba shākya thub pa chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can a shwattha'i shing drung du bzhugs pa/ shar du sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs sa gnon dang mnyam gzhag can pa to la'i shing drung du bzhugs pa/ byang shar du bde gshegs gtsug tor can mchog sbyin mnyam gzhag mdzad pa puṇḍa rī ka'i shing drung du bzhugs pa/ shar lhor rgyal ba thams cad skyob pa skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag can sā la'i shing drung du bzhugs pa/ nub tu thub pa 'khor ba 'jig ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can shīrṣa'i drung du bzhugs pa/ lho nub tu 'dren pa gser thub chos 'chad mnyam gzhag can u dumbā ra'i shing drung du bzhugs pa/ nub byang du skyob pa 'od srung g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba lta bu 'dzin pa n+ya gro dha'i shing drung du bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog gser btso ma'i kha dog can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od dang 'od zer 'bar ba'o// lho ru khro bo chen po sngon po mchan khung ral gri dang zhags pa bcug cing thal mo sbyar ba/ khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o// byang du phyag na rdo rje zhi ba ljang gu g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon gdan la brten pa rol pas bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o// sgo bzhir shar du yul 'khor srung dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ lhor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu spyan mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du rnam thos sras ljang ser ne'u le 'dzin pa rnams su gsal bar gyur/

gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/ dzaḥ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing gas mtshan par gyur/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs dang bdag gi bsod nams dang smon lam gyi stobs dang rig sngags kyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la mchog tu rgya chen po byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa las mngon par mtho ba'i mchod pa'i sprin chen po rab tu 'phro bar gyur cig ces dang*/ na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa manta swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags lan brgyad bzlas pas mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams mchod// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ sgra snyan/ zhes dang*/ arghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shabda zhes pa bcug la so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/

cung zad spro na 'dod yon lnga ni/ phyogs dus kun na gzugs sgra dri dang ro// reg bya'i khyad par phun sum tshogs pa rnams// mos blos bde gshegs sras bcas la 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ de nas rin chen bdun ni/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la// bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis// 'gro ba mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ sapta ma hā ratna badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'bul ba ni/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar// bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa la// bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi// oṃ aṣṭa maṅga laṃ badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bstod pa rgyal ba spyi bstod ji ltar 'os pa sbyar chog la/ mdor bsdus gser 'od las 'byung ba ni/ rgyal ba zla ba dri ma med pa'i sku// rgyal ba nyi ma 'od zer stong gi 'od// rgyal ba padma dri ma med pa'i spyan// rgyal ba me tog pad rtsa rdul med tshems// rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu ste// rin po che ni du ma'i 'byung gnas gyur// rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes chu yis gang*// ting 'dzin brgya phrag stong gis kun tu gang*// rgyal ba'i zhabs ni 'khor lo bris 'dra ste// 'khor yug mu khyud de bzhin rtsibs ma stong*// phyag dang zhabs ni drwa bas spras pa ste// zhabs kyi drwa ba ngang pa'i dbang po bzhin// gser gyi ri bo lta bur rab tu gda'// rgyal ba dri med gser gyi ri dbang po// yon tan thams cad ri dbang 'dra ba ste// sangs rgyas ri dbang rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba chu zla 'dra// nam mkha' dang yang mtshungs shing 'dra ba ste// sgyu ma smig rgyu lta bur chags pa med// rgyal ba dri ma med la phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas bzlas pa bdag bskyed skabs su smos pa ltar ci 'grub bya/

rig gtad mi byed na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gtor ma 'bul/ mchod bstod sogs rjes kyi cho ga rnams bya'o// ༈ /gsum pa rig pa gtad pa'i cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor mchod gtor gong smos ltar/ rin po che'i bum pa gtsang ma dri bzang po'i chu dang bum rdzas nyer lngas bkang ba kha rgyan mgul chings kyis spras pa gnyis bsham/ bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed bzlas pa grub kyi bar btang*/ de nas bum pa/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ shū n+ya tās sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa ser po yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha rdzas kyis dkris pa'o// oṃ tapte tapte ma hā tapte swā hā/ lha yi chu bo rab tu 'bab par gyur/ oṃ kalpa bṛkṣā ya swā hā/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan par gyur/ dbus kyi bum pa'i steng du rin po che dang pad zla'i gdan bdun/ las bum gyi steng du pad zla'i gdan gnyis dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun sogs mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bdun 'khor dang bcas pa byon nas gdan la bzhugs par gyur pa ni/ dbus su rgyal ba shākya thub pa sogs bdag bskyed skabs ltar la/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyogs bzhi nas rgyal po chen po sde bzhi rang rang gi dpung dang bcas te zhabs 'bring bgyid pa'o// las bum gyi steng du pad zla'i gdan gcig la khro bo chen po nas cha byad rdzogs pa'o// cig shos la gsang pa'i bdag po nas/ rin po ches brgyan pa'o// mchod pa kha gsos la byin brlab/ chu gnyis nyer spyod 'bul/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gis bstod/ lha rnams kyi sku las byung ba'i bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar gyur/

ces dmigs la so so'i gzungs bdun re las mi nyung ba dang*/ spyi'i snying po brgya rtsa tsam bzla/ las bum gyi khro bo gnyis la/ oṃ bi kṛ ta daṃṣṭe/ a mo gha sa ma ye/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ sarba bidya a mo gha/ a bhi ṣe kai/ hūm̐ mi li mi li swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig las mi nyung bar bzla'o// gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i gtor snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ a kā ro lan gsum mam bdun ci rigs kyis phul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// sogs 'dod don gsol/ rnam pa gcig tu na 'jig rten 'das gtor med kyang chog go /'jig rten pa'i gtor ma sngags drug phyag drug gis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams mdun du bkug par gyur/ a kā ro lan bcu gcig gis bsngo/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs mya ngan 'tshang la gnas// rgyal ba gtsug tor padma dkar po'i drung*// thams cad skyob pa sā la'i drung na gnas// bram ze 'khor ba 'jig ni shīrṣi'i drung*// sangs rgyas gser thub u dum bā ra'i drung*// 'od srung n+ya gro dha yi drung na gnas// shākya thub mchog a shwattha drung du// phyi nas byang chub thob gyur gau ta ma// sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul chen po de dag la// mngon par dad pa'i lha gang 'khod pa dag /lha rnams de dag yid dga' mgu gyur nas// rtag tu dge zhing zhi bar 'gyur bar mdzod// ces brjod la gtor ma dor/ gatstsha gatstsha swa bhā wa naṃ/ zhes mgron rnams gshegs/ slar yang bum lhar dmigs te/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ phyag byar 'os pas bstod/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ me tog dkar po dang bcas pa'i mchod yon phul/

badzra muḥ lha rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus bya/ nang du 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal btab/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi rig pa gtad pa zhu ba'i yon tu maṇḍal phul/ zhes maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon gyis bdag la rig sngags dam pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ thog mar rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du/ bde bar gshegs pa dpa' bo chen po bdun gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan mkha' khyab kyi sems can mtha' dag sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pas phyag 'tshal ba sogs bsags sbyong yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin rtse gcig pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ji snyed su dag sogs bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa lan gsum/ de nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa rnams theg pa chen po'i tshul lugs las ji ltar 'byung ba ltar legs par gsal thob la 'di'i rjes zlos/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs lan gsum/ skabs 'dir sngags kyi che ba mang du brjod par gsungs pa ni/ de'ang lus can rnams kyis don tu gnyer bya gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad du phan bde'i 'byung gnas bla na med pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che kho na yin la/ de 'thob bar byed pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i theg pa'am gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa zhes bya ba 'di kho na yin te/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gshegs par 'gyur ba de dag kyang lam 'di nyid kho na la brten nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shing 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba yin pas/ rgyud las kyang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon pa// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen pas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// 'jig rten rjes 'jug bcad nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// zhes 'byung ba yin/

de yang pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo nas byang chub sgrub pa ni dka' ba mang ba dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa dang bral zhing*/ dus yun ring pos byang chub 'thob pa'i phyir bul la/ gsang sngags 'di ni thabs la mkhas pa rgya che zhing*/ dka' ba med pa dang bde bas bde ba bsgrub pa'i tshul gyis dus yun thung ngu la thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob par gyur ba'i phyir dbang po rnon po'i spyod yul du gyur pa ste/ de lta bu'i lam 'dir 'jug pa la'ang*/ nyams su blang bya'i don po rtsa ba'i gzhi rten lta bur gyur pa ni/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā thas/ srid zhi'i gnas na phun tshogs kun gyi phul// bla med byang chub sgrub par byed pa'i lam// rdo rje theg pa las gzhan yod min na// lam de'i rtsa ba lha yi rnal 'byor yin// srid lam 'khyams zhing dub pa'i sdug bsngal rnams// kun gyi rtsa ba tha mal snang zhen te// de nyid sbyong bar byed pa'i thabs mang yang*// lha sku'i rnal 'byor kho na gtso bo yin// lhag pa'i lha kun ye shes ngo bor gcig /sku yi rnam 'gyur gcig pu kho na yis// mos pa tha dad drang bar mi nus pas// dkyil 'khor du ma sprul zhing bshad par mdzad// ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'bras dus kyi sku dang zhing khams la sogs pa'i snang cha dang mthun pa'i gzugs sku'i rnam pa lam byed lha'i rnal 'byor gyi thabs mkhas sgom pa nyid 'bras bu lam du byed pa ste theg pa 'di'i lam gyi rtsa ba'am gzhi ma lta bu yin la/ de yang gdul bya'i skal ba dang 'tshams par ye shes gcig nyid rnam pa thams cad pa'i dkyil 'khor du ston par mdzad pa las/ da lam 'dir gang bshad par bya ba ni/ so sor thar pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob// 'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srungs dang*// shākya thub pa gau taṃ lha yi lha// mi 'dul kha lo bsgyur ba bla na med// 'jig rten mgon po skyob pa'i mchog

/sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun po ste// grags ldan rnams kyis so sor thar// 'di ni rab tu rgyas par ston// ces gsungs pa ltar/ bskal pa 'di'i sngon rol bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la bcom ldan 'das rnam gzigs 'jig rten du byon/ de'i rjes kyi drug cu pa la gtsug tor can byon/ de'i rjes bzhi bcu tham pa la thams cad skyob byon/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la mi rnams kyis tshe lo bzhi khri thub pa na bcom ldan 'das log par dad sel lam 'khor ba 'jig 'jig rten du byon/ sum khri thub pa na gser thub byon/ nyi khri thub pa na 'od srungs byon/ tshe lo brgya ba'i gnas skabs na bdag cag gi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'jig rten du byon pa yin/ de ltar na sangs rgyas bdun po de dag sngon thugs bskyed pa'i gnas skabs nas bzung 'gro ba'i don du mchog tu dpa' bo'i phyir/ sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun zhes grags pa yin/ de yang spyir de dang 'dra ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas pa byon mod kyi/ bdun gyi grangs su bcad pa ni phyogs 'jig rten khams 'di'i dbang du byas/ dus kyang sangs rgyas gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'i dbang du byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun po 'di dag ni 'dul ba'i bstan pa la bslab pa phra mo thams cad kyang gcig pa yin la/ gzhan dang gzhan dag ni gnad kyi dgongs don gcig tu zin yang bcas mtshams sna tshogs pa dag ni yul dus so so'i gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa'i khyad par las mang nyung rgyas bsdus yangs dog ma nges pa sna tshogs su yod pa'i rigs su gda'/ des na 'phags pa'i yul sogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rnal ma yod pa'i phyogs su ni de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sku gzugs bzhengs pa dang gsol ba 'debs pa la sogs pa'i srol shin tu dar ba yin la/ phyogs 'dir yang bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su chos kyi rgyal po 'jig rten dbang phyug srong btsan sgam pos 'phrul snang bar khang du sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi snang brnyan bzhengs par mdzad pa lta bus mtshon te shes par nus/

de bzhin gshegs pa bdun po 'di'i sgrub thabs rgya gar du dar ba mang zhig yod mchi na'ang bod 'dir 'gyur ba med la/ dus phyis sangs rgyas bdun pa'i gzungs la sogs pa dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs 'di nyid/ yul lho phyogs ra khang tsag mar sku 'khrungs pa ma hā paṇḍi ta grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon shākya rakṣi ta zhes bya ba la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su gsungs shing slob dpon des yi dam sna tshogs pa'i sgrub thabs brgya dang brgyad phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa'i nang tshan du gtogs pa yin/ de nyid nas rim par brgyud de rgya gar shar phyogs kyi slob dpon chen po gang ba'i rdo rje las rje btsun rdo rje 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrol ba'i mgon pos gsan te yi dam rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas su bzhugs pa las/ rje btsun dam pa nas brgyud pa'i bka' srol mang du gyes te da lta'i bar du bar ma chad par bzhugs pa ste/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun pa'i rig gtad bgyi ba la thog mar bya ba'i rim pa rnams grub zin nas/ dngos gzhi'i thog mar bar du gcod pa'i bgegs skrod pa yin snyam du mos shig ces mtshams sbyar la/ gtor ma'i nang du me tog bdug spos sogs mchod pa btab pa gcig bshams pa chab kyis bran/ bsang sbyang brlab/ a kā ros bsngo/ bden stobs spyi ltar brjod la/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir rdo rje'i slob ma rnams la rig pa gtad pa'i cho ga bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa rnams kyis bgegs rnams kyi mgo bo tshal ba brgyar bkas nas rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya'o// zhes dang*/ drag sngags bzla zhing gul yungs rdor dril rol mo'i tsham rngam bcas bskrad/

de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid rin po che las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i dbus su zhes pa nas sa bon bskyed tshig sogs bor ba'i mngon rtogs ji bzhin brjod de/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dang bcas pa mngon sum du bzhugs yod snyam pa mdzod/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar sgo'i phyi rol du khyed rang 'khod pa la lho byang gi khro bo gnyis kyis khyed rang la nad gdon sogs bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs rab tu zhi bar bya ba'i phyir bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ bi kṛ ta daṃṣṭe sogs brjod la/ las bum spyi bor bzhag cing dbang bskur/ bum pa'i chus khrus byas pas khyed rang gi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon bar du gcod pa'i tshogs thams cad dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas dud khu 'dzag pa ltar nag nyil gyis phyir thon/ lus phyi nang thams cad shel dkar gyi bum pa dri ma med pa ltar dkar sangs sangs gyur pa la bdud rtsis khengs par mos shig bum chus kha bshal/ khrus bya zhing khro bo chen po'i sngags kyi mthar/ sarba bā pe bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ sngags mthar/ sarba bi ghāṃ bhyaḥ sarba duṣṭāṃ bhyaḥ sarba gra he bhyaḥ sarba dzwa re bhyaḥ sarba byā dhi bhyaḥ sarba u pa dra we bhyaḥ sarba a kā la mṛ tyu bhyaḥ sarba duḥpwa sna bhyaḥ sarba durni mitti bhyaḥ sarba tsitta ku le bhyaḥ zhes sbyar bas bkru zhing khong du'ang btang*/ lag g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung mtheb chen gyis mnan/ sor mo gsum rdo rje rtse gsum tshul du byas pas bum pa'i kha rgyan thogs la/ byab rdzas kyi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer byung*/ bkrus pas ma dag pa'i lhag ma thams cad tsen gyi blangs nas dri ma'i zla la bskur bar gyur par dmigs la khro sngags sham du/

sarba pā pe bhyaḥ.a pā na ya swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pas byabs la khrus chu phyir dor/ mdun bskyed khro bo'i dbang po rnam pa gnyis las sna tshogs rdo rje phra mo char ltar babs nas khyed rang gi lus la rdo rje'i go cha zhu lubs su g.yogs pas phyin chad sdig sgrib nad gdon bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed pa'i srung ba chen po byas par mos shig rdo rje gnas bdun du rgya gram tshul gyis bzhag la/ sngar gyi sngags rnams kyi mthar/ rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ btags pa brjod la bsrung*/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du khrid de shar sgo'i nang rol du 'khod pa la gtso bo la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa phyag gis thogs te spyi bo nas blugs/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad sbyangs te mngon par dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ 'gro mgon shākya thub pa rgyal rigs brtson 'grus can// tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su ser skya'i grong bltams shing*// a shwattha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya a nu ga te oṃ ku ruṃ gi ni swā hā/ tatya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ oṃ na maḥshākya mu ni ye ta thā ga tā ya swā hā/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bde gshegs rnam par gzigs ni rgyal rigs gzi brjid can// tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus su grong khyer mnyan ldan du// mya ngan 'tshang gi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya a nu ga te oṃ ku ruṃ gi ni swā hā/ oṃ na mo bi pa shye ta thā ga tā ya swā hā/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bde gshegs gtsug tor mnga' ba rgyal rigs rdzu 'phrul can// tshe lo bdun khri'i dus na ka n+ya'i grong khyer na// puṇḍa rī ka'i shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog

/na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya a nu ga te oṃ ku ruṃ gi ni swā hā/ oṃ na maḥshi khi ni ta thā ga tā ya swā hā/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rgyal ba thams cad skyob pa rgyal rigs blo gros can// tshe lo drug khri'i dus na grong khyer mnyam med du// shing mchog sā la'i drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /na maḥsarba ta thā ga hṛ da ya a nu ga te oṃ ku ruṃ gi ni swā hā/ oṃ na mo bi shwa bhū dze ta thā ga tā ya swā hā/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ thub pa 'khor ba 'jig ni stobs ldan bram ze'i rigs// tshe lo bzhi khri'i dus na bde ldan grong khyer du// shing mchog shīrṣa'i drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya a nu ga te oṃ ku ruṃ gi ni swā hā/ oṃ na maḥkra kuta tshanda ta thā ga tā ya swā hā/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ 'dren pa gser thub bslab pa mchog ldan bram ze'i rigs// tshe lo sum khri'i dus na grong khyer mdzes ldan du// u dum wā ra'i shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /na maḥsarba tā thā ga ta hṛ da ya a nu ga te oṃ ku ruṃ gi ni swā hā/ oṃ na maḥka na ka mu na ye tā thā ga tā ya swā hā/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ skyob pa 'od srung rgyal rigs bla med yon tan can// tshe lo nyi khri'i dus na wā rā ṇa sīr ni// n+ya gro dha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya a nu ga te oṃ ku ruṃ gi ni swā hā/ oṃ na maḥkā shya pa ta thā ga tā ya swā hā/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de nas lha bsgom pa dang sngags bzla ba'i lung 'bogs pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus tha mal du snang ba'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs/

de'i ngang las gzhal med khang gi dbus su nas/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dang bcas pa gsal 'debs par mdzod/ mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung*/ zhal nas thon khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying gar pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ re re'i mthar 'khod pa'i mos pas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la rgyas par na gzungs rnams dang*/ bsdu na mtshan sngags dang spyi sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum gsum byed du gzhug spro na/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags dang*// bcom ldan 'di la sogs bya/ de ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi rjes su gnang ba dam pa brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes 'phags yul mkhas pa'i bzhed gzhung ma nyams shing bod kyi rtog bzo'i bsre lhad ma zhugs pa bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gi brgyan pa legs par grub pa lags/ zhes brjod/ dam tshig bsdus te khas blang*/ gtang rag maṇḍal sogs spyi ltar bya/ rjes chog mchod pa kha gsos la byin brlab/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus/ nongs bshags bzod gsol bya/ ye shes pa rten la brtan bzhugs sam gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa'i 'khor lo 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang yang snying ga'i sa bon la thim par gyur/ dge ba bsngo/ shis brjod sogs spyi ltar byas pas 'grub bo// rgyal mchog 'di dag kun la grags che yang*// sgrub thabs rig gtad khungs dang 'brel ba dkon// 'di byas dge bas kun kyang tshul 'dir zhugs// dpa' bo chen po'i go 'phang sgrub byed shog /ces pa'i tshul 'di sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi sdebs su bzhugs pas rig gtad dkyus 'gre tsam dar srol che'ang rtsa gzhung nyid bsdus ches pa'i dbang gis nyams len dang lag len tshul bzhin byed pa dkon pas/ thub bstan yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag kun gzigs bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas bka'i gnang ba stsal ba ltar blun sgom rgan po blo gros mtha' yas kyis rdzong shod sgrub gnas su bklags chog gi yi ger bkod pa dge legs 'phel//

// ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
